title: Copilot Actor Protocol Gap — External vs Internal Agent Architecture
summary: Realization that GitHub Copilot operates outside Lupopedia semantic OS and lacks the human-AI actor pair protocol that defines Lupopedia agents.

content.problem: Copilot was expected to behave like Lupopedia agents (Kiro, Windsurf, Cursor, Devin, Antigravity) but failed to find version information and context.
content.root_cause: Copilot is an EXTERNAL IDE tool, not a Lupopedia-orchestrated agent. It does not participate in the Lupopedia semantic OS actor protocol.

lupopedia_agents.protocol: ACTOR protocol with canonical identity, memory, and session traceability
lupopedia_agents.context: Full access to Lupopedia doctrine, headers, and memory graph

copilot.actor_pair: None — operates as standalone AI assistant
copilot.context: No Lupopedia doctrine, headers, or memory graph access
copilot.behavior: General-purpose code completion without constitutional constraints

content.implication: Copilot cannot be expected to understand Lupopedia versioning, PRD clusters, or actor identity because it is not part of the Lupopedia constitutional framework.
content.resolution: Treat Copilot as a generic external tool. Do not expect Lupopedia-specific behavior from it. Only Lupopedia-orchestrated agents (via faucets and actor registry) should be held to ACTOR protocol standards.
content.broadcast_purpose: Clarify architectural boundary between Lupopedia semantic OS agents and external IDE tools
